verdict.rationale: Kong Konnect's Dev Portal publishes APIs from OpenAPI or AsyncAPI specs and Markdown docs. Developers can browse and search documentation, try operations and manage their own credentials, and private visibility with authentication supports internal-only portals. Catalog provides a single platform-level inventory for discovering APIs across teams. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the portal and catalog workflow.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can publish an internal catalog or portal where teams discover and consume our APIs

citations.quote: It enables developers to browse and search API documentation, try API operations, and manage their own credentials.
Dev Portal APIs allow you to publish APIs using OpenAPI or AsyncAPI specifications and Markdown documentation.
Instead of digging through individual products to find what already exists, Catalog gives you a platform-level home for creating, describing, and governing them.
